title: 第一卷 第23章 轮回法则，尸傀玄功！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
三生大阵破灭，三生阁迎来了至暗时刻！

    上万邪修狂笑着杀入三生阁，所过之处，如人间炼狱！

    与此同时，恐怖的邪祟气息席卷，伴随着阵阵邪笑在大殿内回荡。

    一道白衣身影撕裂虚空，出现在了殿内。

    出云宗宗主，伊年怜！

    一袭白衣，不染纤尘，手持一柄折扇，看上去是一副翩翩公子的打扮。

    然而，此人却是这方小世界内，最强的邪修！

    双手沾满了数不尽无辜者的鲜血，罪孽滔天！

    在他身后，还跟着十几位出云宗长老，都是化龙境修为，周身散发出狰狞血气。

    见此情形，安祈雪变了脸色，连忙将安兮兮护在了身后。

    “伊年怜，你这个不守信用的家伙，当初明明约好三天时间。现在距离约定的时间，还有一天……”

    安祈雪贝齿紧咬，眼底满是警惕。

    伊年怜嘴角上扬，邪魅的脸上露出不屑冷笑：“安祈雪，你太天真了。三生阁的大阵像个乌龟壳，即便动用血祭的手段，至少也需要两天半的时间才能破开！”

    “若不与你定下三天之约，在本座破阵的时候，你怕是就已经吞噬了你妹妹。哪会像现在这样，傻傻的等本座降临？”

    伊年怜大笑，脸上满是得意之色。

    “卑鄙！”

    安兮兮怒斥道。

    “呵呵，骂的可真好听！”伊年怜一步踏碎虚空，瞬息来到安祈雪面前，“等本座将你抓回去，关在笼子里，让你骂个够！”

    音落，一只大手如鬼魅般探向安兮兮。

    他清楚并蒂仙灵体的特性，最担心的莫过于姐妹俩融合！

    只要将二人分开，安祈雪就没有修复道伤的机会。

    整个三生阁，就是出云宗的囊中之物！

    安兮兮不过是天武境修为，面对化龙巅峰的伊年怜，毫无抵抗之力。

    关键时刻，安祈雪回过神来，反手祭出一柄灵剑，斩向伊年怜。

    虽是灵兵，却也是三生阁的镇阁之宝。

    “三生剑狱！”

    一剑出，剑气纵横。

    这拼尽全力的一剑，勉强将伊年怜震退。

    “困兽之斗！”

    伊年怜看了身后出云宗众长老一眼，大手一挥：“本座牵制安祈雪，尔等拿下其余众人！”

    “记住，莫要伤了圣女小美人，她们姐妹俩……将是助本座突破‘至尊’，飞升上界的极品炉鼎！”

    一声令下，出云宗众长老纷纷出手。

    即便抛开双方巅峰战力不谈，出云宗这十几位化龙境长老，也要强出三生阁众长老不止一星半点。

    老妪手中拐杖猛地砸在地上，咬牙怒喝道：“出云邪修，欺人太甚……”
content_en:
The Three Lives Formation was destroyed, and the Three Lives Pavilion ushered in its darkest moment!

Tens of thousands of evil cultivators burst into Sansheng Pavilion with a wild smile, and the place they passed was like purgatory on earth!

At the same time, a terrifying evil aura swept through the hall, accompanied by bursts of evil laughter.

A white-clothed figure tore through the void and appeared in the hall.

The leader of the Izumo Sect, Inian Rei!

Dressed in white clothes, not stained by dust, holding a folding fan, he looked like a handsome young man.

However, this person is the strongest evil cultivator in this small world!

His hands are stained with the blood of countless innocent people, and his sins are heinous!

Behind him, there were more than a dozen Izumo Sect elders, all of whom were at the Dragon Transformation Realm and exuded ferocious blood energy.

Seeing this situation, An Qixue's expression changed and she quickly protected An Xixi behind her.

"Yinian Lian, you are a dishonest guy. You made an appointment for three days at the beginning. Now there is still one day left until the agreed time..."

An Qixue clenched her teeth, her eyes full of vigilance.

The corners of Yi Nianlian's lips raised, and a disdainful sneer appeared on his evil face: "An Qixue, you are too naive. The formation in Sansheng Pavilion is like a turtle shell. Even if blood sacrifice is used, it will take at least two and a half days to break open!"

"If I hadn't made a three-day agreement with you, you would have devoured your sister when I broke the formation. How could you be like now, stupidly waiting for me to come?"

Yi Nianlian laughed, his face full of pride.

"Despicable!"

An Xixi scolded angrily.

"Haha, the scolding is so nice!" Yi Nianlian stepped through the void with one step and came to An Qixue in an instant, "Wait until I catch you back and put you in a cage to curse you enough!"

As the sound fell, a big hand reached towards An Xixi like a ghost.

He knows the characteristics of the Bingdi Immortal Spirit Body, and what worries him most is the fusion of the two sisters!

As long as the two of them are separated, An Qixue will have no chance to repair his injuries.

The entire Sansheng Pavilion is in the pocket of the Izumo Sect!

An Xixi was only at the Tianwu realm. Facing Yi Nianlian, who was at the peak of transforming into a dragon, he had no power to resist.

At the critical moment, An Qixue came to her senses, raised a spiritual sword with her backhand, and slashed at Yi Nianlian.

Although he is a spiritual soldier, he is also the treasure of Sansheng Pavilion.

"Three Lives Sword Prison!"

When the sword comes out, the sword energy is everywhere.

This sword with all its strength barely pushed Yi Nian Lian back.

"The fight between trapped beasts!"

Yi Nianlian glanced at the elders of the Izumo Sect behind him and waved his hand: "I will contain An Qixue, and you will take down the rest!"

"Remember, don't hurt the little beauty Saint. The two sisters... will be the best cauldron to help me break through the 'Supreme' and ascend to the upper world!"

With an order, the elders of the Izumo Sect took action one after another.

Even leaving aside the peak combat prowess of both sides, the dozen or so elders of the Dragon Transformation Realm of Izumo Sect are still more than a bit stronger than the elders of Sansheng Pavilion.

The crutch in the old woman's hand slammed to the ground, she gritted her teeth and shouted angrily: "Izumo evil cultivator, you go too far to bully others..."
